question: By how many percentage points did the surface fluorine mass ratio fall through the Cyrene-based separation?
rendered:
According to the document, the mass ratio of fluorine element on the surface of the cathode rejects was 12.49%, and that value was greatly reduced to 0.14% after the Cyrene-based separation process.

The difference is 12.49% - 0.14% = 12.35%.

So, the surface fluorine mass ratio fell by 12.35% points through the Cyrene-based separation.
